topic: Apple Watch Repairs for Constantia Kloof
summary:
Cracked Apple Watch screen, a battery that won't last the day, or a watch that stopped charging? If you're in Constantia Kloof, you don't need to drive across town.

Our workshop at Silvercrest Shopping Centre in Silvamonte is about 25 km away, roughly 38 minutes' drive. For a flat R300, we collect your watch from your door and return it once it's fixed, insured both ways.

We repair every Apple Watch from Series 1 to Ultra. Every job starts with a free diagnostic, so you know the cost before any work begins, and repairs carry a 6-month warranty.

Tap Learn more for Constantia Kloof collection details.
